# Skoci — Ultra-lightweight Agent-Native Deployment Platform
> Self-hosted deploy platform: AI agents deploy, humans validate via dashboard, apps run on user VPS.

## Key Facts
- Single Rust binary (<20MB idle RAM target, zero extra daemons)
- Zero shell string interpolation (safe against prompt injection)
- CLI & MCP tools return structured JSON with {code, message, fix} error format
- Secrets are encrypted at rest with ChaCha20-Poly1305 (protected node.key, refused startup if missing with stored secrets) and never returned to model context; tokens (sk_agent_*, sk_master_*) and Bearer headers are redacted in logs
- Policy is built-in to the server; production actions, historical rollbacks, and restores require human approval
- Zero SSH required after initial setup: all agent operations use scoped HTTPS tokens over pinned TLS (:8443 with SPKI pin)

## Exit Codes & Statuses
- 0: Success (`live`)
- 1: General error (action failed, build failed, invalid config from validate/init)
- 2: Approval pending/required (subsequent production promotions via scoped token, or first when `--strict-approvals` is active; production rollback to historical versions older than last known-good; database restore; app delete)
- 3: Authentication / TLS error (unauthorized, scope_violation, pin_required, pin_mismatch, rate_limited)
- Deploy Statuses: `live` (healthy), `degraded` (health check passed, GET / failed; route automatically reverts to previous container and removes broken container; stays live if no prior route), `failed` (build/startup error)
- Concurrency: Deploy, promote, rollback, and delete on the same app are mutually exclusive; concurrent actions return `conflict` error naming the active deployment/deletion ID.

## Agent Rules & Guidelines
1. Always run commands with `--json` for machine-parsable outputs.
2. In case of error, inspect `error.code`, read the `error.fix` recommendation, and execute the suggested fix.
3. Never use or request SSH access after initial server setup. Connect using `skoci connect --server <server-ip> --token <token> --pin sha256:<spki-pin>` (writes `~/.config/skoci/servers.json` `0600` by default; pass `--project-env` to also write `.skoci/env`).
4. Never print, log, or echo tokens (`sk_agent_*`, `sk_master_*`).
5. Production deployments require genuine custom domains (magic DNS `*.sslip.io` is auto-enabled by `skoci server setup` when `--domain` is omitted for preview, but rejected in production by default; operator override: `skoci server setup --allow-magic-dns-production` or `SKOCI_ALLOW_MAGIC_DNS_PRODUCTION=true` in `/etc/skoci/skoci.env`; accepted booleans: `true/false`, `1/0`, `yes/no`, `on/off`). Verify DNS before deploying with `skoci domain check <host>`.
6. Treat `degraded` deployments as a failure to investigate: smoke test failed so the route reverted to the previous container while the broken container was removed (or stays live if no prior route existed); check logs with `skoci logs --tail 100 --json` and never promote a degraded deployment.
7. Promotion & Rollback Approval Flow: Master token promotes and rolls back directly. With a scoped agent token (`sk_agent_*`), an app's first promotion to production goes live immediately by default (unless `SKOCI_REQUIRE_APPROVAL_ALWAYS=true` is set via `skoci server setup --strict-approvals`); every subsequent promotion produces an approval request (exit code 2, `pending_approval`). Production rollback to the immediately preceding version (last known-good) is allowed without approval; rolling back to older versions requires approval (exit code 2, action `rollback`). The agent cannot approve its own request and must surface `Request ID: appr_…` to a human operator who runs `sudo skoci approve <request_id>` on the server or approves via the web dashboard.
8. The project build always executes on the server inside Docker. The local machine does not require Docker.
## Agent Workflow
1. Connect: `skoci connect --server <server-ip> --token sk_agent_<app>_<hex> --pin sha256:<spki-pin>`
2. Initialize: `skoci init` (migrates legacy `skoci.yaml`/`.env.skoci` to `.skoci/`; infers app name from `package.json`, `Cargo.toml`, or `pyproject.toml`, falling back to directory name; validates format upfront; generates `.skoci/skoci.yaml`, non-root `.skoci/Dockerfile` including `nginxinc/nginx-unprivileged:1.27-alpine` on port 8080 with internal-file 404 rules for static sites, and `.skoci/ignore`; strips `.skoci/` from built image)
3. Validate: `skoci validate [path] [--verbose] --json` (offline validation of `.skoci/skoci.yaml`, domains, and secrets; `--verbose` lists exact files to upload, total bytes, and excluded paths using explicit filter order: built-in defaults, project-root `.gitignore`, `.skoci/ignore` or `.dockerignore`; exit 0 valid, 1 invalid)
4. Configure: Adjust `.skoci/skoci.yaml` (`app`, `run.port`, `domains`, `services`).
5. Verify Domain: `skoci domain check <host>` (ensures A/AAAA points to server before cert issuance)
6. Set Secrets: `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>` (encrypted on host)
7. Deploy to Preview: `skoci deploy --env preview --json` (verify status is `live`, not `degraded`)
8. Verify: Check health check, URLs, and smoke test status
9. Promote to Production: `skoci promote "<reason>" --json` (first promotion goes live immediately by default; subsequent promotions return exit code 2 and request ID for `sudo skoci approve <id>`)
10. Monitor: `skoci status --json` and `skoci logs --json`
## CLI Commands Reference
- `skoci server setup --host <ip> [--user <u>] [--port <n>] [--ssh-key <path>] [--ssh-copy-id] [--ssh-password-stdin] [--app <app>] [--version <tag>] [--magic-dns] [--domain <domain>] [--email <email>] [--harden-ssh] [--no-ufw] [--strict-approvals] [--yes] [--allow-magic-dns-production]` (one-time setup of remote VPS from laptop, Skoci >= 0.4.0)
- `skoci validate [<path>] [--verbose] [--json]` (offline validation of `.skoci/skoci.yaml` and upload manifest, no network/deploy, exit 0 valid, 1 invalid)
- `skoci connect --server <ip> [--token <token>] [--pin <spki-pin>] [--name <profile-name>] [--no-profile] [--project-env]`
- `skoci domain check <host>` / `skoci domain add <host>`
- `skoci domain set <host> --primary [--force]` (admin/master token only: moves the server's base domain, re-points live routes to `<app>.<host>`, dashboard to `skoci.<host>`)
- `skoci deploy [--env preview|production] [--detach] [--commit <sha>]`
- `skoci watch <deployment_id>`
- `skoci deployments [--app <app>] [--limit 20]`
- `skoci status [<app>]`
- `skoci logs [<app>] [--env <env>] [--tail 100]`
- `skoci secret set <KEY> <VALUE>`
- `skoci secret list`
- `skoci promote "<reason>" [--version <v>]`
- `skoci approvals`
- `sudo skoci approve <request_id>` / `sudo skoci reject <request_id>` (admin only on server)
- `skoci rollback [--env preview] [--to <version>]`
- `skoci doctor`
- `skoci db backup [service=db]`
- `skoci db list`
- `skoci db restore <backup_id> [service=db]` (requires approval)
- `skoci app delete [<app>]` (requires approval)
- `skoci token create --app <app> [--name <name>]` (admin only)
- `skoci token list --app <app>` (admin only)
- `skoci token revoke --app <app> --name <name>` (admin only)
- `skoci agent-guide`
